verdict.rationale: Fern documents a local preview server with hot reload and two ways to preview docs changes before publishing. This lets users test documentation and configuration changes without touching the live production site, but it is a preview workflow, not a true sandbox environment. Missing for 10: an isolated sandbox or test API environment (e.g., sandbox base URLs or test credentials for the API playground and SDKs), explicit separation of production data, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, and independent corroboration.
